    The degree-two part of the mesh ideal #

    Lemma 4.13: "Since Φ preserves the mesh ideal, whose degree-two part from τX to X is spanned by the mesh relation at X, it multiplies that relation by some ν_X ∈ k*. Comparing coefficients gives w(σa) w(a) = ν_X for every mate pair at that mesh."

    The mesh ideal is spanned by composites u r_Y v; their degree-two parts from τX to X are those with u, v of degree zero, hence Y = X and u, v scalars (proj_two_mem_span). A linear relation among the composites (σa) a in C(Q, c) is therefore proportional to the mesh coefficients (mesh_coeffs).

    References #

    • Multiplicative bases and deformations of representation-finite algebras, https://github.com/haruhisa-enomoto/multiplicative-bases-deformations. Numbered statements cited here refer to it.

    theorem LargeIndecomposable.ScalarMeshCategory.proj_two_comp {k : Type u} [Field k] {V : Type v} [Quiver V] {Q : TranslationQuiver V} [(x : V) → Fintype ((y : V) × (y ⟶ x))] (c : MeshCoefficients k Q) (x z : ↑Q.nonprojective) (u : LinearPaths.obj ↑(Q.tau x) ⟶ LinearPaths.obj ↑(Q.tau z)) (w' : LinearPaths.obj ↑z ⟶ LinearPaths.obj ↑x) :
    (LinearPaths.proj 2 ↑(Q.tau x) ↑x) (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp u (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (meshRelation c z) w')) = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp ((LinearPaths.proj 0 ↑(Q.tau x) ↑(Q.tau z)) u) (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (meshRelation c z) ((LinearPaths.proj 0 ↑z ↑x) w'))
